posts.text: Apply! To qualify as a Campus Lead, you must: - Be enrolled in an undergraduate college or university program as of August 2026 and expect to graduate after December 2027 - Be able to commit 4 to 6 hours per week from August 2026 to June 2027 - Not currently be an ambassador or intern for another AI program or company If we know each other and you’re interested, feel free to reach out. Happy to give out a couple referrals!

Over the past few weeks, as part of OpenAI’s ChatGPT Lab program, I had the opportunity to host an event in collaboration with Western AI where students explored more practical and creative ways to use ChatGPT in their everyday lives. The goal was to move beyond the usual “use ChatGPT for quick answers” conversation and create a space where students could share real workflows, ask questions, and think more critically about how AI can support the way we study and solve problems.
